text: Natural Language Processing (NLP) is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand and work with human language. One of its main goals is text understanding, which allows machines to find meaning in written words. NLP is also used for translation, so people can read texts in different languages more easily. Another useful application is sentiment analysis, which helps companies discover whether customers feel positive, negative or neutral about a product. Finally, chatbots use NLP to communicate with people in a natural way, answering questions and providing support online. Thanks to NLP, our interaction with technology is becoming simpler and more human every day.
